scope: GPU world lookup at actual road/terrain/floor mesh intersections versus independent rays through posed car triangles at all nine PCF texel centres; closed, open/steered/tilted, and raised/rotated/suspension poses
limits: The filtered reference uses posed triangles and inverse light projection; it never reads GPU depth values and includes partial PCF edges
Masked-only ray hits are excluded from the opaque triangle oracle; alpha masks have separate GPU fixtures
This tests receiver conformity and car shadow projection, not vehicle collision clearance or world geometry casting onto the car
